'''Tarasin Way''' was a street that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Osten Dal'Nay]] lived in Tarasin Way for a time, during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
